summary: Phase 6 Quoting & Billing UI testing complete. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified all required data-testids and full quote lifecycle (create draft → approve → finalise to Sage).
seed_data_creation: Created test cases via /api/svc/intake/phone endpoint for lifecycle testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 Billing is fully functional. Backend endpoints tested: GET /api/svc/billing (with status filters), GET/PUT /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/quote, POST auto-fill/approve/void, GET invoice/preview, POST invoice/finalise. Frontend verified: billing-page, billing-filter, billing-refresh, billing-back, billing-row-{ref}, billing-open-{ref}, quote-editor drawer with all line management, totals, and lifecycle buttons. Sage invoice push is MOCKED (outbox only - status flips to 'ready').

mocked_apis.sage_200_invoice_push: Outbox only - svc_sage_invoice_outbox.status flips draft → ready; live POST in Phase 8

backend: GET /api/svc/billing?status=ready|quoted|invoiced|all - returns chargeable cases with billing_state
GET /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/quote - returns case and quote (null if none)
PUT /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/quote - creates/updates draft with Q-NNNNN reference, version++
PUT on approved quote returns 409 (cannot edit)
POST /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/quote/void - works on draft/approved, 409 on invoiced
GET /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/invoice/preview - returns Sage payload with Lines, QuoteReference, QuoteTotal
POST /api/svc/billing/{case_id}/invoice/finalise - requires approved quote, flips to invoiced, upserts outbox
frontend: Billing page with filter, refresh, back link, and billing rows
Quote Editor drawer with title, status pill, auto-fill button
Line table with kind/desc/qty/unit/total columns and remove button
VAT and Discount inputs with live recalc of totals
Save draft creates Q-NNNNN, shows draft status
Approve quote flips to approved, inputs become read-only
Finalise → Sage shows invoiced badge and success toast
